pay_date.title: pay_date
pay_date.description: The date when the check amount is paid to the employee.

pay_period_start.title: pay_period_start
pay_period_start.description: The date when the pay period begins. Some platforms, like unemployment portals, do not have fixed pay periods.

pay_period_end.title: pay_period_end
pay_period_end.description: The date when the pay period ends. Some platforms, like unemployment portals, do not have fixed pay periods.

gross_pay_amount.title: gross_pay_amount
gross_pay_amount.description: The total earnings before any deductions are made, in cents.

gross_pay_ytd.title: gross_pay_ytd
gross_pay_ytd.description: The cumulative year to date total earnings before any taxes or deductions are removed, in cents.

net_pay_amount.title: net_pay_amount
net_pay_amount.description: The total earnings after all taxes and deductions are removed, in cents.

net_pay_ytd.title: net_pay_ytd
net_pay_ytd.description: The cumulative year to date total earnings after all taxes and deductions are removed, in cents.

earnings.title: earnings
earnings.description: The earnings for this pay period, in cents.

taxes.title: taxes
taxes.description: The taxes for this pay period, in cents.

deductions.title: deductions
deductions.description: The deductions for this pay period, in cents.

time_off.title: time_off
time_off.description: The user's time off balances for this pay period. To enable time off balances, please contact Pinwheel support.
